title: Use the lead’s designs as the default for incremental review
summary: James requested that subsequent design questions start from the lead’s existing designs and simplify them. The preserved plan assigns Mid-360/IMU to geometry and odometry, D455 to forward depth, and leaves the separate survey LiDAR unspecified. The smallest proposed acquisition test is a stationary Mid-360 recording with independently checked ground geometry and visibility. It is not a qualified survey payload or research authorization.
next: Review the single stationary-recording milestone using the existing Mid-360; define its fixture and acceptance before implementation or acquisition.
